fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg reminder table
fields.description: The table tenant.psql creates in the orleans schema of every shard database.

members.name: orleans_reminder
members.description: reminder_id identity primary key; grain_key bytea (the serialized grain key), grain_type varchar(1023), reminder_name varchar(150), unique together; start_time timestamptz; period bigint (TimeSpan ticks); grain_hash bigint (indexed); version integer.
